title: Inbox triage: spoofed payroll mail
description: Read a reported message the way an analyst would: headers, authentication results, reply-to, and the real destinations behind the links. Everything here is a fictional Northwind Lab sample.
learningObjectives: Separate display name from the envelope From address
Read SPF, DKIM, and DMARC results in Authentication-Results
Hover-check every URL before treating it as the claimed brand
Explain why a reply-to mismatch is an investigation lead

steps.title: Identify the sending domain
steps.prompt: What domain is in the From address of the payroll message?
steps.hint: Look at From, not the display name.

steps.title: Authentication
steps.prompt: Did SPF pass, fail, or none on the payroll message?

steps.title: Link destination
steps.prompt: What hostname does the 'Open payroll portal' link actually resolve to in the template?
steps.hint: Rendered view hover, or the URLs list in Engine.

steps.title: Reply-To
steps.prompt: Is Reply-To the same as From? Answer yes or no.

hints: Display names are free text. The address after @ is the claim you can test.
A fail on SPF plus a lookalike domain is stronger than urgency language alone.
Open the Engine tab on this sample to see extracted artifacts.

Team,

The overnight payroll submission for Northwind Lab was rejected by the bank gateway.

Open payroll portal

Regards,
Payroll Operations
Northwind Lab
